Kit summary

Divine Hammer BlowBasic
Deals [Bleed] DMG by 13% of Oliver's Max HP to a single enemy, with a 50% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn.
Divine ArbitramentActiveExclusive Lv.3
Selects an ally and transfers all their debuffs to a random enemy; meanwhile, grants [Stealth] on all allies except for the selected one for 2 turns. Afterward, deals [Bleed] DMG by 12% of Oliver's Max HP to all enemies, with a 70% chance to inflict [Heavy Bleed II] for 2 turns.
Hammer of Holiness Lv.3When Oliver casts Divine Arbitrament, if he has 80% or more Shield Effect currently, grants all allies [SPD Up Ⅱ] for 2 turns; if he has 120% or more Shield Effect, also grants all allies [Mastery Up II] for 2 turns.
Shelter of Sword HarborPassiveExclusive Lv.1
When a battle starts, for every 1% of the initial Effect Hit Oliver has, additionally increases Max HP by 0.24%, up to 36% can be increased this way; for every 1% of the initial Healing Effect Oliver has, additionally increases Shield Effect by 0.3%, up to 30% can be increased this way.
Hammer of Holiness Lv.1After an ally takes DMG from enemies' basic attacks or skills (including pursue-and-attack and counterattack), Oliver gains [Light of Sword Harbor] (increases Shield Effect by 1%, up to 30% can be increased this way).
Sheen of ValkyrieActiveExclusive Lv.2
For every 1% of the current Shield Effect Oliver has, grants all allies [Divine Hammer Subdual] (increases all allies' [Bleed] DMG by 0.3%), up to 120% of Shield Effect can be calculated. Afterward, restores all allies' HP by 18% of Oliver's Max HP and grants them 2 layers of [Light Shield] by 20% of Oliver's Max HP.
Hammer of Holiness Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, Oliver casts Sheen of Valkyrie once. When an ally's turn ends, if they have fewer than 2 layers of [Light Shield], grants them 1 more layer.
